# Tenant Email for Rent Increase and Heater Repair

A calm, professional note can ask for two things at once: repair of the heater and a clear explanation of the rent increase. Keep the tone factual, courteous, and dated.

## Draft Email and Record-Keeping Plan

**Subject:** Request for Heater Repair and Clarification of Rent Increase Notice

Dear [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I am writing regarding two issues at my apartment at [address/unit].

First, the heater has not been working properly, and I have already reported this in writing twice. Please let me know when the repair will be completed and who will be handling it.

Second, I received a notice dated March 18, 2026 stating that my rent will increase by 14% beginning May 1, 2026. Please confirm the new monthly rent amount and the basis for the increase.

I would appreciate a written response and a repair timeline at your earliest convenience. Thank you for your attention to these matters.

Sincerely,
[Your full name]
[Phone number]
[Email address]

## Documents to Keep Organized

| Document | What to Save | Why It Matters |
|---|---|---|
| Rent increase notice | Copy of the notice dated 2026-03-18 | Shows the stated increase and effective date |
| Heater repair requests | Emails, portal messages, texts, letters | Proves you reported the issue in writing |
| Landlord replies | All written responses and attachments | Keeps the full communication history |
| Photos or videos | Date-stamped images of the heater or room conditions | Helps show the condition over time |
| Maintenance records | Work orders, technician visits, repair notes | Tracks whether repairs were attempted |
| Lease and addenda | Current lease, renewals, amendments | Keeps the rental terms in one place |
| Payment records | Rent receipts, bank statements, ledger screenshots | Confirms what you paid and when |
| Contact log | Dates, names, and summaries of calls or visits | Helps reconstruct the timeline |
| Copies of everything sent | PDF or screenshots of your messages | Protects against missing or deleted messages |

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Save Email Draft] https://www.google.com/search?q=how+to+save+email+draft+in+gmail
Action: [Button: Create Document Folder] https://support.google.com/drive/answer/2375091
Action: [Button: Track Messages] https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/create-and-send-email-in-outlook-0f6b6f3e-5c0a-4d1f-9a1b-0b0d4c7d6d0d

## Sources

- City of Chicago tenant resources: https://www.chicago.gov/city/en/depts/doh/provdrs/renters.html
- Illinois tenant and housing information: https://www.illinoislegalaid.org/
- U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development renter guidance: https://www.hud.gov/topics/rental_assistance/tenantrights
